item.title: Octopus Died in Australia, and Lived in Hong Kong
item.description: One technology, two sales pitches delivered one after another — one buyer said no, the other said yes. The refusal came from Australia; the acceptance came from Hong Kong. Decades later, Hong Kong became the first place in the world to use the Octopus card. The most interesting part is not the technology itself — a technology’s fate is not decided in the laboratory, but in the soil it lands on. So why did it come alive in Hong Kong of all places?
